# Bebasthapan ERP — Full Technical & Product Context Specification

## Executive Overview

Bebasthapan ERP is an end-to-end cloud business management platform engineered for small to medium enterprise (SME) businesses, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and service providers operating in Nepal. It unifies operations across accounting, inventory management, sales, purchasing, customer relationship management (CRM), human resources (HR), and employee attendance into a single real-time dashboard.

## Full Capability Matrix

### 1. Accounting & Financial Management
- **Chart of Accounts (COA)**: Hierarchical asset, liability, equity, revenue, and expense structure.
- **Journal Vouchers & Double-Entry Bookkeeping**: Full debit/credit voucher recording with approval workflows.
- **Financial Statements**: Real-time generation of Trial Balance, Profit and Loss (P&L), and Balance Sheet reports.
- **Tax & Compliance**: VAT reporting support, PAN number validation, IRD compliance invoice data backing, debit/credit note tracking.
- **Accounts Receivable & Payable (AR/AP)**: Ageing reports, party balance tracking, automated receivable/payable calculations.

### 2. Inventory & Stock Management
- **Stock Tracking**: Item-wise stock balances, valuation, unit of measurement (UOM) configurations.
- **Movement History**: Real-time stock movement logs triggered by sales invoices, purchase bills, and manual adjustments.
- **Low-Stock Alerts**: Automated threshold notifications for reorder points.

### 3. Sales Operations & Invoicing
- **Quotations & Sales Orders**: Create, send, and convert quotations directly into orders and tax invoices.
- **Client Payment Management**: Track partial payments, full settlements, payment methods (e.g. eSewa, Bank Transfer, Cash).

### 4. Purchasing & Expense Management
- **Purchase Orders & Bills**: Supplier bill management, expense tracking, and debit note issuance.
- **Supplier Payment Ledgers**: Quick payment recording and balance reconciliation for suppliers.

### 5. CRM & Customer Dues
- **Customer Directory**: Customer profiles, credit limits, communication history, and overdue tracking.

### 6. HR & Attendance Management
- **Employee Profiles**: Staff records, role-based security permissions.
- **Attendance Log**: Daily clock-in/clock-out tracking tied to operations.

### 7. AI Business Intelligence & Predictive Analytics
- **AI Insights Engine**: Operational analysis, revenue/expense trend detection, financial health checks.
